mapper.select: select B.id, B.tenant_id, B.create_by, B.create_time, B.create_user_id, B.user_id, A.username, A.full_name, A.email, A.mobile, C.id account_id from sys_user A join sys_tenant_user B on A.user_id = B.user_id left outer join sys_user_account C on A.user_id = C.user_id and B.tenant_id = C.tenant_id ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select A.id tenantId, A.tenant_code, A.tenant_name, A.tenant_short_name, A.platform_yn, B.use_yn from sys_tenant A JOIN sys_tenant_user B ON A.id = B.tenant_id JOIN sys_user U ON U.user_id = B.user_id WHERE B.user_id = #{userId} AND A.delete_yn = 0 AND A.use_yn = 1 AND ( (A.expire_time is null AND A.effect_time is null) OR (A.effect_time <= #{now} AND A.expire_time >= #{now}) ) order by case when B.default_yn = 1 then 1 when A.id = U.last_login_tenant_id then 2 else 3 end, A.seq
